correctness.rationale: A complete explicit basis of angular Fourier modes and radial sine modes diagonalizes the exact geometric crossing indicator. Direct boundary-condition calculations fix all signs and normalizations; parity makes the Green inverses nonsingular. Odd factorizations count every spectral multiplicity. Trace-class powers and absolutely convergent odd Dirichlet series give cycle laws for every integer length at least three. A separate standard-library checker independently enumerates all 3–5-chord labeled diagrams and tests the Fourier eigenmodes and multiplicities. Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the universal proof.

originality.rationale: In inspected primary literature the boundary crossing probability, spatial intersection distribution, uniform chord diagrams and general circle-graphon representation are known. Their statements do not entail the full signed odd-divisor spectrum or zeta family without new analysis. The 1982 Gates comparator may have low-order chord-count data and its full text could not be retrieved. Thus historical priority is provisional, and only the full spectrum with derived all-cycle law is assessed as new.
residual_risks: An unknown earlier spectral diagonalization under circle-graph/operator terminology could preempt historical priority.
